versions.content: Mapping of signals to different physical lines Type: valid Description: The System Constraint Description shall be able to describe, if needed, that signals between ECUs are sent via different physical lines. Rationale: To support hardware and information redundancy (as a mean to support fault detection and fault handling). Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: A mean to guarantee the transmission of very safety critical data, is to force the sending of redundant copies onto different physical lines. Supporting Material: –
